status: prospective; implementation and review before competition-data fitting
hypothesis: Numeric token and decimal patterns may transfer between related columns. Add16 hierarchical, internally cross-fitted target logits to the current R10 representation. This tests a pattern hypothesis, not a claim that the competition generator has been recovered.

inspiration.scope: Own implementation of the hierarchical estimation idea. Do not execute the external script, select joint keys globally, use outer-validation early stopping, import its predictions or inherit its reported validation claims.

validation: Exploratory full-data StratifiedKFold5/42, all known labels and same ordered IDs/folds as R10. Hierarchical statistics are cross-fitted5 times within outer training, with the prior computed only from the corresponding inner training subset. Inference uses only outer-training statistics. No independent holdout or outer-validation early stopping.

hierarchy.groups: Full fractional text and first fractional digit across the four fields; full fractional text and last integer GPT2 token across the two fields; four per-field pairs of last integer token and full fraction.
hierarchy.canonical_text: Decimal(str(float64(x))) in fixed notation, at least one fractional digit, no additional quantization. Equivalent numeric spellings are merged; lexical CSV spelling is not preserved.
hierarchy.unknown: Group token backs off to inner/outer training prior; field token backs off to its group; unseen pair backs off to its field/fraction. No validation or test labels.

fixed_comparisons.selection: Report every fixed share; choose the highest pooled OOF among eligible shares. This finite selection remains exploratory. No added weights after seeing the outcome.

promotion_rule: Exceed R10 hybrid pooled OOF by strictly more than0.0001 and improve at least4/5 matching folds. Otherwise record the negative result and retain R10. At most one submission after independent source/data/ID/fold/label/formula/checkpoint audits; no exception preauthorized.
training_gate: Publish this plan and tested implementation, review crossfit boundaries and absent-flag compatibility, then fit in an isolated clean pinned worktree. No paid compute.
